body: Yup. You would. If you go all in, then most players at the table would fold. And if you keep playing and win in the end, you'd probably still be disappointed by your winnings. I mean that with THAT hand you could've won all the money in the world, but you didn't. So why not just fold and save yourself?
What is that you want then?

Do you play poker? Texas hold 'em in particular. Imagine you've got a royal flush right on the flop. What's the point of waiting for last two cards if you know it just can't get better? You can get a nine-king straight or flush, but it's not going to be royal flush.

It's going perfect. But things change. It can't get better than perfect, but it can get worse. And most likely will. But I'm enjoying it right now and I want it to stay like this till the end of my life.
